wikipedia#1.title: 1996: Abdullah Çatlı, a leader of the ultra-nationalist Grey Wolves, was killed in a car crash near Susurluk, Turkey, sparking a scandal that exposed the depth of the state's complicity in organized crime.

wikipedia#2.title: 1969: U.S. president Richard Nixon made a plea for support from the "silent majority", referring to those Americans who did not join in the large demonstrations against the Vietnam War at the time.

wikipedia#3.title: 1957: The Soviet Union launched Sputnik 2, carrying the space dog Laika as the first living creature to enter orbit around Earth.

wikipedia#4.title: 1956: Suez Crisis: During an invasion of the Gaza Strip, Israeli soldiers shot and killed hundreds of Palestinian refugees and local inhabitants in Khan Yunis.

wikipedia#5.title: 1954: The first film (poster pictured) featuring the giant monster Godzilla was released nationwide in Japan.

wikipedia#6.title: 1948: The Chicago Daily Tribune published the erroneous headline "Dewey Defeats Truman" (pictured) in its early morning edition shortly after incumbent U.S. president Harry S. Truman officially upset the heavily favored governor of New York Thomas Dewey in the presidential election.

wikipedia#7.title: 1943: The Holocaust: The largest massacre of Jews by German forces began at the Majdanek concentration camp in occupied Poland.

wikipedia#8.title: 1942: World War II: U.S. Marines and U.S. Army forces began an attempt to encircle and destroy a regiment of Imperial Japanese Army troops on Guadalcanal.

wikipedia#9.title: 1935: In a widely criticised referendum, almost 98 percent of Greek voters supported the restoration of George II (pictured) as King of the Hellenes.

wikipedia#10.title: 1898: The Fashoda Incident ended with French forces withdrawing after several months of military stalemate with the British in Fashoda (now in South Sudan).

wikipedia#11.title: 1881: Indigenous Mapuche began an uprising against the occupation of Araucanía by Chile.

wikipedia#12.title: 1880: The current melody of Kimigayo, the national anthem of Japan, was adopted.

wikipedia#13.title: 1848: A new constitution drafted by Johan Rudolph Thorbecke was proclaimed, limiting the powers of the Dutch monarchy.

wikipedia#14.title: 1812: French invasion of Russia: As Napoleon's Grande Armée began its retreat, its rearguard was defeated at the Battle of Vyazma.

wikipedia#15.title: 1805: War of the Third Coalition: The Treaty of Potsdam was signed compelling Prussia to join the coalition if it failed to negotiate peace between Russia and France.

wikipedia#16.title: 1793: French Revolution: Playwright, journalist and outspoken feminist Olympe de Gouges  was guillotined.

wikipedia#17.title: 1534: The Parliament of England passed the first Act of Supremacy, making King Henry VIII head of the Church of England, supplanting the pope and the Catholic Church.
